newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY STABLE TO FIRMER.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY STABLE TO FIRMER.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted stable to firmer against major currencies at the close of Wednesday's quiet interbank session, dealers said.
"We didn't really see any big movements today. The dollar was confined to a fifty cent movement," one dealer said, adding:
"But the market was slightly short. We saw some guys buying but it wasn't anything too big."

The local currency ended the day at Tuesday's 11.6300/6400 against the U.S. unit but was considerably firmer at 18.5615/5990 versus sterling compared to 18.9300/9500, tracking a stronger U.S. dollar on the British currency overseas.
It was at 6.1895/2020 from 6.2000/2100 on the mark and at 2.4860/4910 against the rand from 2.5000/5100.
